faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lead: Common questions about access, species, security, and in-clinic use.
faq.moreLead: Write to us and we'll help before you register.

items.a: Only licensed veterinarians. During registration we verify your professional license to keep a clinical-only environment.

items.q: What are CDS L4 and L5?
items.a: They are clinical decision support levels: L4 helps structure diagnostic hypotheses; L5 extends reasoning toward evidence-based treatment plans. Always under your professional judgment.

items.q: Which species does the platform cover?
items.a: Dogs, cats, rabbits, birds, reptiles, ferrets, hedgehogs, hamsters, guinea pigs, iguanas, and poultry. Each species unlocks an adapted veterinary form in the consultation.
We apply security and privacy best practices. Records and consultations are managed with access controls per professional account.

items.q: Can I use GUIAA in-clinic and on house calls?
items.a: Yes. It is a web platform: it works in a fixed clinic or on external visits from a tablet or laptop with a modern browser.

items.q: Do I need to install anything?
items.a: No. You access it from the browser. You only need an internet connection and a verified veterinarian account.
